data.long_meaning: Rajendra means 'ruler of kings', Sinh means 'lion'. So, Rajendrasinh means 'Ruler of lion-hearted kings'.

It is a name that inspires one to be a true leader, not just in the material world, but also in the spiritual realm, leading others towards the path of enlightenment and self-realization.
